quote: We compute the attribute relevance with the DeBERTa classifiers for sentiment and topic aspects. We measure the non-toxicity aspect with the Google Perspective API. We consider two auxiliary metrics for text quality, i.e., perplexity (abbr. PPL) and distinctness.
